{{Quote|Perhaps it was the latent mystic abilities of my own race mingling with the flame-god itself or perhaps it was something&hellip;greater.|Cody Sunn-Childe|<ref name="Marvel" />}}
The '''Jashwik''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|orange]]-skinned, jowled [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jashwa]] and were related to the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. [[Cody Sunn-Childe]] was a Jashwik. He once theorized that his species was possibly a naturally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] one.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Jashwik_body.png|thumb|left|Full body shot of Jashwik]]
Like their [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] cousins from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="Vegas" /> the Jashwik were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]], two legs, and a head. Their face had a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and a [[Nose/Legends|nose]], two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], all arranged in the same approximate positions as on a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] head. They had peach-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin and their thick-lipped mouths were filled with white, blunt [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Their eyes were globulous and [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-shaped, with a yellowish sclera and a small black pupil. Their arms ended in hands with four long, claw-like fingers, including an opposable thumb to aid grasping.<ref name="Marvel" /> Contrary to the Sullustans, who sported wide, round [[Ear/Legends|earlobes]],<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> the Jashwik had tapered ears. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] of the species also had the ability to grow [[Hair/Legends|hair]], both on the top of the head and on the cheeks and chin. The Jashwik also had knees that bent forward, thus allowing them to sit on their buttocks with their back upright. During emotional stress, a Jashwik would go though a perspiration process to maintain normal body temperature. It was speculated that the whole species was naturally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|keenly attuned]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Marvel" /> a mystic energy that flowed through all living things and bound [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] together,<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> but only in a latent way.<ref name="Marvel" />

==Society and culture==
Some male Jashwik favored shoulder-length hairstyles and [[Clothing/Legends|dressed]] in bright colors&mdash;including yellow, red and blue. At least one individual was known to have worn [[Leather/Legends|leather]]-like high [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with a blousing shirt and a [[Cape/Legends|cape]].<ref name="Marvel" />

==History==
The Jashwik originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jashwa]]. They were related to the Sullustans, a diminutive species of [[Near-Human]]s from Sullust,<ref name="Vegas" /> who had similar facial jowls and beady eyes.<ref name="AE" />

==Jashwik in the galaxy==
A well-known Jashwik was [[Cody Sunn-Childe]], who was successively the administrator of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Vegas" /> and the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of his own [[City of Dreams|extradimensional city]].<ref name="Marvel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jashwik first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 46|''Star Wars'' (1977) 46]], the forty-sixth issue in the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Marvel Star Wars'']] series of comics, which was published on [[January 20]], [[1981]]. Cody Sunn-Childe, who was introduced and killed off in the very same issue, is the only known representative of this species in [[canon]]. In ''Star Wars 46'', Sunn-Childe only referred to the Jashwik as "my own race."<ref name="Marvel" /> The proper species name was not revealed until [[2013]], when [[Abel G. Peña]] wrote ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'' for the official [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. In the same article, Peña also established the genetic relationship between the Jashwik and the Sullustans, a jowled species first introduced in the [[1983]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Vegas" />
